target: Prove that no same-cut double-bridge pair becomes co-eligible in a frozen exact key by a temporal K-to-R-to-P-to-B-to-K-prime induction.

stage_model.K: exact entry key after pre-unit closure
stage_model.B: raw child input after the selected branch literal and before child pre-units
stage_model.K_prime: reached child exact key after child pre-units

falsified_hypotheses.name: Raw same-cut noncreation
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Two same-cut pairs occur in raw frozen-pass outputs through GT_8.

falsified_hypotheses.name: 553 post-unit pair births
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The extra raw pairs are local Resolution outputs; post-units create zero pairs on the finite GT frontier.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Universal post-unit vacuity
falsified_hypotheses.reason: A GT_5 fresh/fresh complementary-unit pair closes as POST_UNIT_CONTRADICTION before P.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Pure contraction same-cut noncreation
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The complete three-vertex abstract gate finds 36 same-cut births.

falsified_hypotheses.name: All abstract contraction births are opposite-unit conflicts
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The complete one-step four-vertex gate finds 6336 non-unit births.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Two branch-safe sources cannot create a same-cut pair
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The complete two-step four-vertex gate finds 2592 both-safe non-unit births through directed-cycle shield collapse.

raw_same_cut_transients.name: GT_4 mixed entry/fresh transient
raw_same_cut_transients.lifetime: survives to P but not to raw B
raw_same_cut_transients.extinction: under both selected branch polarities the left pivot ceases to be a bridge already in B and the right residual is DIRECTED_CYCLE

proved_theorems.name: Frozen Fresh-Side Barrier
proved_theorems.statement: If K contains no same-cut pair and R=K union F is the frozen-pass output, every same-cut pair first appearing in R contains a fresh side and cannot be co-eligible in that pass.

proved_theorems.name: Cycle-Shield Birth Route Classification
proved_theorems.statement: A newly born same-cut pair from two branch-safe sources requires at least one DIRECTED_CYCLE source whose final cycle shield collapses; spanning-plus-spanning births are impossible.

proved_theorems.name: Post-Unit Total-Component Collapse Barrier
proved_theorems.statement: Before the first component-merging post-unit, all earlier units are internal and preserve external graphs. A branch-safe external unit can exist only with two quotient components, so the first merge collapses the quotient to one component and no same-cut pair survives into P.

proved_theorems.name: Branch-Handoff Same-Cut Route Classification
proved_theorems.statement: An inherited same-cut pair is destroyed when the selected branch crosses its common cut or assigns its pivot. A newly born pair from branch-safe sources requires cycle-shield collapse and two complementary exposed bridges with the same cut.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T2b Selected-Branch Cut-or-Shield Dichotomy
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Every inherited raw same-cut pair is crossed, assigned, or removed by the selected branch; every cycle-shield bridge exposure has no complementary exposed bridge with the same cut.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T3 Temporal Exact-Key Induction
remaining_local_obligations.statement: T0 root absence plus proved T1 and T2a plus T2b preserve same-cut absence in all reached exact keys.

claim_boundary: T1 and T2a are proved under the exact-key induction hypothesis, and the pure branch routes are classified. The GT-specific Selected-Branch Cut-or-Shield Dichotomy, completed local induction, global cache lower bound, and P versus NP remain open.
